SERVICES AGREEMENT

This Services Agreement is made between Northwind Analytics Ltd, a company registered in England (the "Supplier"), and Harbor Foods Ltd (the "Client").

1. Commencement and Term
1.1 This Agreement starts on 1 February 2026 (the "Effective Date") and continues for 12 months.

2. Services
2.1 The Supplier shall deliver a monthly sales dashboard and one analysis report each quarter.
2.2 The Client shall give the Supplier read access to its sales database within 10 working days of the Effective Date.

3. Fees and Payment
3.1 The Client shall pay a fee of £4,500 per month, plus VAT.
3.2 Invoices are payable within 30 days of the invoice date. Late payments carry interest at 4% above the Bank of England base rate.

4. Renewal
4.1 This Agreement renews automatically for further periods of 12 months unless either party gives notice of non-renewal at least 60 days before the end of the current term.

5. Termination
5.1 Either party may terminate this Agreement with 90 days' written notice.
5.2 Either party may terminate immediately if the other commits a material breach that is not remedied within 14 days of written notice.

6. Confidentiality
6.1 Each party shall keep the other's confidential information secret during the term and for 3 years after it ends.

7. Liability
7.1 The Supplier's total liability under this Agreement is limited to the fees paid in the 12 months before the claim.

8. Governing Law
8.1 This Agreement is governed by the laws of England and Wales.

MUTUAL NON-DISCLOSURE AGREEMENT

Dated 15 March 2026 between Alpine Robotics GmbH and Ostara Labs Inc.

1. Purpose. The parties wish to discuss a possible joint venture (the "Purpose").
2. Confidential Information. Each party shall use the other's Confidential Information only for the Purpose and shall not disclose it to any third party without prior written consent.
3. Term. This Agreement remains in force for two (2) years from the date above. The obligations in clause 2 survive for five (5) years after it ends.
4. Return of materials. On request, each party shall return or destroy all Confidential Information within 10 days.
5. Law. This Agreement is governed by Swiss law, and the courts of Zurich have jurisdiction.

COMMERCIAL LEASE (extract)

Landlord: Greenway Properties LLC. Tenant: Bluebird Café LLC.
Premises: Unit 4, 220 Harbor Street, Portland, Oregon.

Section 2. Term. The lease begins on May 1, 2026 and ends on April 30, 2031.
Section 3. Rent. Base rent is $3,250.00 per month, due on the first day of each month. Rent increases by 3% on each anniversary of the start date.
Section 4. Security deposit. Tenant shall pay a deposit of $6,500 before taking possession.
Section 9. Early termination. Tenant may end the lease after the third year by giving six months' notice and paying two months' rent as a fee.
Section 14. Governing law. The laws of the State of Oregon apply.

CONTRAT DE PRESTATION (extrait)

Entre la société Atelier Lumière SARL (le Prestataire) et Maison Verte SAS (le Client).

Article 1 – Durée. Le contrat prend effet le 1er septembre 2026 pour une durée d'un an.
Article 2 – Prix. Le Client verse 12.500,00 € HT, payables en deux fois.
Article 3 – Résiliation. Chaque partie peut résilier le contrat par lettre recommandée avec un préavis de deux mois.

SUBSCRIPTION TERMS

The Customer subscribes to the CloudDesk Pro plan for an initial period of one year starting on the date of the order form. The subscription renews automatically for successive one-year periods at the then-current list price. To stop renewal, the Customer must cancel in the admin console at least 30 days before the renewal date. Fees are billed annually in advance and are non-refundable.

CONSULTING AGREEMENT

The Consultant waives all claims against the Company, including claims for unpaid fees. The Company's liability for any loss, however caused, is excluded in full. The Consultant's liability is unlimited. The Company may terminate this agreement at any time without notice; the Consultant may not terminate before the project ends. This agreement is governed by the laws of Delaware.
